verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS platform with AI features, so a data-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents no setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The sensitive-data evaluator (datadog-docs-21) is an adjacent feature that flags data in LLM inputs and outputs; it is not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
